criterion: line contains one of the Saraiki implosives ٻڄڳݙ
why_not_the_model: Filtering with the classifier would remove exactly the rows it gets wrong and inflate the result by construction. This criterion is orthographic and independent of any model.
is_an_upper_bound: Lines carrying an implosive are longer and more distinctively Saraiki than the rest, so this is an upper bound on Saraiki accuracy, not a corrected figure. Both are reported.
